title: agent-comm-hub agent registry
description: Declarative registry of supported agents for `agent-comm-hub setup` / `discover`. One record per agent; adding a new agent requires a record here (plus a test), no code changes.

id.description: Stable identifier; also the config key default when not overridden.

probe.description: Command names checked against PATH (any hit = agent installed).

items.description: `~`-relative directory; its EXISTENCE means the agent is installed here (must not contain `..`).

probePaths.description: State directories that prove the agent has been used on this machine, for agents that leave no command on PATH.

file.description: Config path template, `~`-relative; one `*` path segment expands over matching subdirectories (e.g. DSH profiles). Must not contain `..`.

section.description: JSON section path (dotted, e.g. `mcp.servers`) for strategy json; null otherwise.

strategy.description: Merge strategy: json = JSON section merge; toml = section append; dsh = YAML insert with marker; yaml-array = a YAML key whose value is a LIST of mappings (Continue), refused when the file's shape is not that.

entry.description: Server entry template; `{url}` / `{serverName}` placeholders are substituted. Null for toml/dsh; required for json and yaml-array.

serverName.description: Optional MCP server key override for this config (defaults to SetupOptions.serverName). DSH uses agent-comm-hub to avoid colliding with a dynamic MCP-manager mount of agent-hub.

os.description: Platforms this FILE applies to; absent means every platform. Needed when one agent uses different files per platform (claude-desktop: a macOS path and a Windows path) — splitting it into two records would duplicate its skill/probe metadata and let the halves drift.

skill.description: Private skill directory (`~`-relative) for this agent; null = no skill.

serverName.description: Optional agent-wide MCP server key override (config-level wins if both set).
